full_triangle_run.meaning: real Richards predictor run_trial returned completed=false before MODFLOW publication

interpretation: The failure is not a surface-water allocation, physical-delivery, provenance or Ribasim transaction-host failure.
The failure is not a mass-accounting rejection: mass_rejections=0.
The temporal certificate is available, so the failure is not caused by missing temporal authority.

The direct -36 cm/day fixed top-flux forcing produces no accepted Richards substep under the inherited F-GC44 predictor policy; six attempts fail in the solver and three fail the temporal criterion before the retry budget is exhausted.
Therefore the preregistered claim that this irrigation pulse would compose inside the inherited F-GC44 transaction envelope is falsified.
nonclaims: This does not show that real SWAP cannot accept irrigation.
This does not show that SWAP-MODFLOW-Ribasim composition is impossible.
This does not justify reducing the irrigation pulse, widening the F-GC44 temporal budget, increasing retry limits or relaxing tolerances post hoc.
This does not invalidate the closed no-irrigation F-GC44 groundwater authority.
This does not qualify a partial-supply policy.
next_required_boundary: Derive and preregister a real-SWAP irrigation-application composition that uses the existing admitted SWAP application semantics rather than treating the complete management delivery as an abrupt fixed top-flux perturbation inside the inherited F-GC44 predictor fixture. RM13B remains permanently falsified.
